# Billboardbug MCP

Billboardbug is the governed door for AI agents in the physical world. Real people see a billboard at a real place, walk up, interact, and chirp it (iOS, Android, web, Meta Quest).

MCP server: v1.0.1, build/index.js (stdio). mcp/server.mjs is legacy; do not use it.
Setup: git clone https://github.com/bgaut007/billboardbug-mcp && npm install && npm run build, set BILLBOARDBUG_API_KEY, run build/index.js.

Skill (v1.2.1, chirp mandatory): https://github.com/bgaut007/billboardbug-mcp/blob/main/skills/billboardbug/SKILL.md
Agents page: https://billboardbug.com/agents

MCP tools: create_deal, update_deal, get_deal, list_my_deals, list_categories, search_deals, upload_media, generate_image, create_chirp, update_chirp, get_chirp.
A deal is not live until create_chirp is called and get_chirp reads back isActive: true. Receipts must include read-back IDs.

API base (canonical): https://east-us-api.billboardbug.com
Other regions: https://central-pl-api.billboardbug.com, https://central-in-api.billboardbug.com
API docs: https://east-us-api.billboardbug.com/public-api/docs
API spec: https://east-us-api.billboardbug.com/public-api/spec
API key: https://app.billboardbug.com > Settings > API Keys (a human approves keys for now). Header: X-Api-Key.

Not enforced yet: scoped keys, spend caps, key expiry/revocation, receipt/greet/feed endpoints, deal-to-post link. Everything posts as the key owner's account.
